text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I lost again... What should I do? I'm...
I'm...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It feels like my engines are on fire!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I thought I could win, but I couldn't! My
heart is
pounding so fast it just might
explode!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I got it! We should start training, like,
right now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But my engines are ready! I can take off
at any
moment now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh! You're totally right! I'd crash if
that
happened!
choice_data_list: 急発進はエンストの元！
choice_data_list_en: Sudden starts will stall your engine!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mayday, mayday! Engine maintenance
required
before takeoff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mayano Top Gun and I start
training
for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ☆ Now that's the Trainer I know
and love!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to get serious!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do some aerobatics, so make
sure you
hold on tight. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Mayano Top Gun
gives training
her all. It looks like she
really does want to
improve!
